_meta.method: WebSearch (official domains) + direct fetch (curl/WebFetch) on 2026-11-03 ~20:45-21:00 UTC, before most polls closed; feed URLs marked verified were fetched and returned the described content. verified_at=null means the page/host could not be fetched (bot protection or not yet switched on) and the URL is taken from search results on the official domain or from an official page that was fetched.

platform_patterns.Scytl/Clarity: <base>/<ST>/<EID>/current_ver.txt -> <ver>; <base>/<ST>/<EID>/<ver>/json/en/summary.json (statewide), electionsettings.json (county file list, gzip), <base>/<ST>/<EID>/<ver>/json/en/<county>.json; elections.json lists EIDs. Used by CO, IA (electionresults.iowa.gov), SC (enr-scvotes.org).
platform_patterns.Enhanced Voting: <base>/results/public/api/jurisdictions/<slug> (elections list + childLocalities); <base>/results/public/api/elections/<slug>/<publicElectionId> (statewide), .../localities (per-county), .../stats, .../turnout, .../vr; ballot-items/<id> per contest. Used by GA, ID, RI, UT, VA, WA.
platform_patterns.ES&S ElectionResults (ASP.NET): <base>/ResultsSW.aspx?type=SW&map=CTY (statewide), ResultsSW.aspx?type=CTYALL&cty=<nn>&map=CTY (county), ResultsMedia.aspx lists resultsCSV.aspx?text=All&type=<CAT>&map=CTY CSV feeds. Used by NE, NM, SD, OR, ND, MT.
